name: quest-guild
description: 悬赏任务公会 - RPG游戏风格的目标管理工具
author: Quest Guild

scripts.prebuild: node -e "const cp=require('child_process');try{cp.execSync('rd /s /q release',{cwd:__dirname,stdio:'pipe'});console.log('已清理 release 目录');}catch(e){if(!e.message.includes('not'))console.log('清理跳过:',e.message.trim())}"
scripts.retry-build: node -e "const cp=require('child_process');const p=require('path');const eb=p.join(__dirname,'node_modules','.bin','electron-builder.cmd');const args=process.argv.slice(2);for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const r=cp.spawnSync(eb,args,{cwd:__dirname,stdio:'inherit',shell:true,env:{...process.env,ELECTRON_BUILDER_CACHE:p.join(__dirname,'.electron-cache')}});if(r.status===0)process.exit(0);console.log('尝试 '+(i+1)+' 失败，'+(i<2?'3秒后重试...':'已达最大重试次数'));if(i<2)cp.execSync('timeout /t 3 /nobreak',{stdio:'inherit'});}process.exit(1);" --
scripts.build: npm run prebuild && npm run build:renderer && npm run retry-build
scripts.build:win: npm run prebuild && npm run build:renderer && npm run retry-build -- --win
scripts.build:win64: npm run prebuild && npm run build:renderer && npm run retry-build -- --win --x64
scripts.build:portable: npm run prebuild && npm run build:renderer && npm run retry-build -- --win portable
